If you wish to get maximum overclocking ability, please tune the turbo controls manually.

Intel XTU is a tool that can alter clock frequency or voltage. Altering clock frequency or voltage may void any product warranties and reduce stability, security, performance, and life of the processor and other components.

Intel® Extreme Tuning Utility saves the state of all tuning settings when Windows shuts down. If this option is enabled, when Windows starts up again, XTU will tune all settings on the system to match the saved values, effectively saving your overclock across system reboots. This functionality is only enabled when the Watchdog Timer is present (See System Information tab)
